name: @teamai/runtime-paseo
description: teamai-runtime-paseo: the step runtime that runs each workflow prompt step as an agent of a Paseo daemon, over runtime protocol 1 on stdio; bundled as its own executable in teamai-cli, never imported by it. It ships no Paseo code: it loads @getpaseo/client from the member's installed Paseo, and these devDependencies serve its types and tests only.
